title: Nitram Anizok / Xanamech Nezmirthafen
summary: Help Nitram Anizok activate Xanamech Nezmirthafen, then defeat the construct and return to Nitram.
overview: Help Nitram Anizok activate Xanamech Nezmirthafen, then defeat the construct and return to Nitram.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Complete Nitram’s three-component hand-in and accompany him along his route to the inactive dragon.
At the activation point, the real Xanamech replaces the inactive model. Prepare the group before Nitram arrives.
The attempt has a two-hour failure timer. After Xanamech falls, return to Nitram promptly: the victory state resets after ten minutes.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
